title: Permutations
prompt: Given an array `nums` of distinct integers, return all possible permutations. You can return the answer in any order.
constraints: All elements of nums are unique.
hints: Backtracking: build a partial permutation, and at each step try every number not yet used.
Track which numbers are 'used' in the current path, either with a set or by swapping in place.
When the partial permutation reaches the full length, record a copy of it.
